Good Afternoon Mohammed,

We would like to inform you that you are welcome to extend your stay for as long as you wish. However, please note that as a holiday home operator, our rates may change on a monthly basis depending on market conditions.

At the moment, we can confirm the current rate for 3 months only. The rate will be AED 4,000 per month (30 nights). A security deposit of AED 2,000 is also required.

Please let us know if you would like to proceed with the booking.
